nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner; set to msg.sender in Ownable and BigerToken constructors and updated in transferOwnership.
Public mapping (address => uint256) of token balances, credited to msg.sender in the constructor and mutated by transfer/transferFrom/burn/freeze/unfreeze.
Public mapping (address => uint256) tracking frozen token amounts per account, updated by freeze and unfreeze.
Public nested mapping (address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spending approvals, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Public uint256 total token supply, initialized as 100 * (10**8) * 10**decimals and reduced by burn.
Public constant string token name 'BigerToken'.
Public constant string token symbol 'BG'.
Public constant uint256 decimals = 18, used in the totalSupply computation.
Public string version '1.0'.
Ownable constructor (function) that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owner-gated function that rejects the zero address and reassigns owner to newOwner.
Internal pure multiplication with zero shortcut and assert(c / a == b) overflow check.
Internal pure division with assert(b > 0) guard.
Internal pure subtraction with assert(b <= a) underflow guard.
Internal pure addition with assert(c >= a) overflow guard.
Token constructor assigning the entire totalSupply to msg.sender, setting owner and emitting Transfer from 0x0.
ERC20 transfer guarded by onlyPayloadSize(2*32); validates destination, self-address and balances using SafeMath for state updates.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without an explicit overflow guard.
Allowance-based transfer guarded by onlyPayloadSize(3*32); moves balances with SafeMath and decrements the allowance.
Owner-gated burn that reduces the caller balance and totalSupply via SafeMath.safeSub.
Owner-gated freeze that moves tokens from balanceOf to freezeOf using SafeMath.
Owner-gated unfreeze that moves tokens back from freezeOf to balanceOf using SafeMath.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
Caller-controlled address used as owner assignment, balance key, allowance key and access-control check input.
Overflow-prone raw addition 'balanceOf[_to] + _value' evaluated inside the transfer require check.
Overflow-prone raw addition 'balanceOf[_to] + _value' evaluated inside the transferFrom require check.
Raw arithmetic constant expression 100 * (10**8) * 10**decimals used to initialize totalSupply.
Address parameter of transferOwnership: the new owner; validated against address(0).
First uint256 operand of SafeMath.safeMul.
Second uint256 operand of SafeMath.safeMul.
Numerator uint256 operand of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Denominator uint256 operand of SafeMath.safeDiv, asserted to be > 0.
Minuend uint256 operand of SafeMath.safeSub.
Subtrahend uint256 operand of SafeMath.safeSub, asserted <= a.
First uint256 operand of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Second uint256 operand of SafeMath.safeAdd.
onlyPayloadSize modifier parameter compared against msg.data.length to mitigate the short-address attack.
Recipient address parameter of transfer, checked against 0x0 and address(this).
Amount uint256 parameter of transfer, checked against the sender balance.
Spender address parameter of approve used as the allowance mapping key.
uint256 approval amount parameter of approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are debited.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount uint256 parameter of transferFrom checked against balance and allowance.
uint256 burn amount parameter of burn checked against the caller balance.
uint256 freeze amount parameter of freeze checked against the caller balance.
uint256 unfreeze amount parameter of unfreeze checked against freezeOf.
Local uint256 product c = a * b in SafeMath.safeMul validated by assert(c / a == b).
Local uint256 quotient c = a / b in SafeMath.safeDiv.
Local uint256 sum c = a + b in SafeMath.safeAdd validated by assert(c >= a).

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, flowing untrusted caller input into the owner state variable.
BigerToken constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full totalSupply.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
burn is restricted to the owner through the onlyOwner modifier check on msg.sender.
freeze is restricted to the owner through the onlyOwner modifier check on msg.sender.
unfreeze is restricted to the owner through the onlyOwner modifier check on msg.sender.
BigerToken constructor reads totalSupply to mint the initial balance and emit Transfer.
Raw exponent/multiplication expression 100 * (10**8) * 10**decimals determines the value written into totalSupply.
transfer debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] via SafeMath.safeSub/safeAdd.
transfer evaluates the overflow-prone expression balanceOf[_to] + _value in its require statement.
balanceOf values feed the raw addition used in the transfer overflow check.
approve writes _value into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] and credits balanceOf[_to] using SafeMath operations.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom evaluates the overflow-prone expression balanceOf[_to] + _value in its require statement.
balanceOf values feed the raw addition used in the transferFrom overflow check.
burn subtracts _value from balanceOf[msg.sender] using SafeMath.safeSub.
burn reduces totalSupply through SafeMath.safeSub(totalSupply, _value).
freeze subtracts _value from balanceOf[msg.sender] using SafeMath.safeSub.
freeze adds _value to freezeOf[msg.sender] using SafeMath.safeAdd.
unfreeze subtracts _value from freezeOf[msg.sender] using SafeMath.safeSub.
unfreeze adds _value back to balanceOf[msg.sender] using SafeMath.safeAdd.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner after the zero-address check.
newOwner parameter is validated and written into the owner state variable.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub for the balance debit and allowance decrement.
burn calls SafeMath.safeSub for the balance and totalSupply updates.
freeze calls SafeMath.safeSub for the balance debit.
unfreeze calls SafeMath.safeSub for the freezeOf debit.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
freeze calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the freezeOf credit.
unfreeze calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the balance credit.
safeMul operand a flows into the multiplication expression.
safeMul operand b flows into the multiplication expression.
safeDiv numerator a flows into the division expression.
safeDiv denominator b flows into the division and the assert(b > 0) guard.
safeSub minuend a flows into the subtraction expression.
safeSub subtrahend b flows into the subtraction and the assert(b <= a) guard.
safeAdd operand a flows into the addition expression.
safeAdd operand b flows into the addition expression.
Local product c = a * b is computed and validated by assert(c / a == b) inside safeMul.
Local quotient c = a / b is computed inside safeDiv and returned.
Local sum c = a + b is computed and validated by assert(c >= a) inside safeAdd.
onlyPayloadSize size parameter is compared to msg.data.length on transfer.
onlyPayloadSize size parameter is compared to msg.data.length on transferFrom.
Recipient _to is validated and used as the balanceOf credit key in transfer.
Amount _value is validated against the sender balance and used in the SafeMath updates.
_spender is used as the inner allowance mapping key in approve.
_value is written directly into the allowance mapping in approve.
_from supplies the source balance and allowance keys in transferFrom.
_to is validated and used as the balanceOf credit key in transferFrom.
_value is checked against balance and allowance and used in the SafeMath updates.
_value is checked against the caller balance and subtracted in burn.
_value is checked against the caller balance and moved into freezeOf.
_value is checked against freezeOf and moved back into balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter exists only to be validated and stored by transferOwnership, so it is folded into that function node.
Operand a is a transient input of the safeMul arithmetic core node.
Operand b is a transient input of the safeMul arithmetic core node.
Numerator a is a transient input of the safeDiv arithmetic core node.
Denominator b is a transient input of the safeDiv arithmetic core node.
Minuend a is a transient input of the safeSub arithmetic core node.
Subtrahend b is a transient input of the safeSub arithmetic core node.
Operand a is a transient input of the safeAdd arithmetic core node.
Operand b is a transient input of the safeAdd arithmetic core node.
The onlyPayloadSize size argument only guards call data length and is abstracted into the transfer core node.
_to is only used for validation and as the balanceOf credit key inside transfer.
_value is only used for balance validation and SafeMath updates inside transfer.
_spender is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
_value is only written into the allowance mapping inside approve.
_from only supplies the balance and allowance keys read and written inside transferFrom.
_to is only validated and used as the balanceOf credit key inside transferFrom.
_value is only checked and applied through SafeMath inside transferFrom.
_value is only validated and subtracted from the caller balance and totalSupply inside burn.
_value is only moved from balanceOf to freezeOf inside freeze.
_value is only moved from freezeOf back to balanceOf inside unfreeze.
Local product c is a temporary holder of the multiplication result inside safeMul.
Local quotient c is a temporary holder of the division result inside safeDiv.
Local sum c is a temporary holder of the addition result inside safeAdd.
